_comment: Per-Island decor art keys (Art/Incoming keys) used by the editor builders (IslandDecor.cs). IslandCoastBuilder.BuildBoundary: 'trees' replaces deco_tree on the playable-edge ring, 'props' replaces the green bush there, 'bigProps' are 2-cell props mixed into those spots (30 %); 'lip' is the Island's own W/E/N edge lip used as drawn (IslandDressingBuilder.EdgeLipTiles, else the shared lip recoloured); 'floes' are ice floes stamped on the pond water (IslandDressingBuilder.EnsurePond); 'iceHoles' are 2-frame ice-fishing hole sprites laid on the pond ice shelf (IslandDressingBuilder, FrameFlicker; decor only, fish spawning is not touched); 'underside' is the Island's own hanging piece instead of vines / roots (IslandCoastBuilder.BuildUnderside); 'snowfall' is an fx key drawn as an overlay over the whole Island (SnowfallOverlay; hidden under Motion: calm); 'swaps' give this Island its own art for a shared node / fixture key (ArtIntake.Integrate; the '_flow' loop of the new key comes with it). A key that is not in Art/Incoming falls back to the default art. A key delivered in two or more world sizes is also reachable as '<key>_<W>x<H>' with W x H in 32-px texels (ArtKeys.SizeAliases): 'deco_snow_props_32x48' = the 1x1 props, 'deco_snow_props_64x64' = the 2x1 props, each the @64 drawing (64x96_8f@64 / 128x128_4f@64, ART-SPEC 3.9.8 step D) once delivered, else the 32-px file; '<key>_<w>x<h>' also names each file by its own canvas (deco_snow_props_128x128). ART-SPEC 3.8 (snowy Fishing).
